title: Throughput and latency sweep for FP8/INT8 quantized profiles with calibration pipeline
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Measure throughput and latency trade-offs for FP8 and INT8 quantized model variants across realistic workloads, focusing on: batching interaction, long-context behavior (KV cache effects), calibration sensitivity, and end-to-end accuracy regression. Deliver a reproducible benchmark suite and recommended quant profiles for production rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark harness can run nightly for both FP8 and INT8 variants with configurable batch size and context length
Report output includes p50/p90/p99 latency, throughput (tokens/sec), memory footprint, and per-layer calibration diagnostics
Accuracy validation compares quantized outputs to float32 baseline on the eval set and flags regressions > 0.5% on critical metrics
Calibration pipeline artifacts (scale tables, per-channel stats) are stored and indexed; pipeline includes automatic fallback if calibration diverges
Runbook with recommended quant profiles and batching guidance produced and reviewed by Runtime and ML teams
steps: Define representative workload presets (interactive, streaming small-batch, bulk embed-like large-batch) and long-context scenarios (4k, 16k, 64k tokens)
Create calibration datasets: (1) synthetic token distributions, (2) production-sampled prompts (anonymized), (3) adversarial prompts that stress numeric ranges
Implement calibration runner that emits per-layer histograms, dynamic range, and suggested quant params for FP8/INT8
Integrate quantized variants into benchmark harness (continuous batching, prefix caching enabled), add KV cache warmup rules
Run grid sweep: batch sizes [1,4,8,16,32], context lengths [4k,16k,64k], quant modes [fp8, int8 symmetric, int8 asymmetric], schedule across GPU types
Collect and aggregate metrics, produce comparison dashboard and telemetry alerts for regressions
Draft recommended profiles and follow-up tickets for profiling hotspots and kernel tuning
notes: Preliminary runs show FP8 gives ~1.25x throughput vs INT8 on A100-like hardware for batch sizes >=8 but has wider variability in tail latency under streaming workloads
INT8 symmetric calibration is more stable across context lengths but may require per-layer bias correction for attn-softmax layers
KV cache memory savings are non-linear with quant format; INT8 reduces KV footprint significantly for very long contexts (>=16k), which can affect batching decisions
Calibration dataset composition materially affects per-layer scale choices; production-sampled prompts reduce accuracy regressions vs purely synthetic calibration
We must ensure CI gating does not run the full grid; implement fast smoke runs that validate critical permutations
comments: 2025-02-19 - Aisha Patel: Initial experiment runner merged into feature/quant-bench. Added synthetic and anonymized-prod calibration inputs. Observed NaN occurrences in FP8 runs when sequence length > 32k under aggressive kernel fusion.
2025-02-22 - Markus Chen: Reproduced NaN on a different cluster. Temporary mitigation: disable specific fused kernel for FP8 when context > 32k. Filed ENG-13135 to track kernel-fix work.

2025-02-25 - Sarah Lopez (ML Research): Evaluated accuracy on eval-llm-v2.0: FP8 baseline drift at edge cases (numeric stability in layernorm). Proposed a light per-layer re-scaling step during calibration.

2025-02-27 - Priya Nair (Runtime): Added KV warmup sequence to benchmark harness to ensure fair tail-latency measurement. Noticed that without warmup, first-request p99 is dominated by lazy allocation for INT8 cache buffers.

2025-03-01 - Markus Chen: Snapshot of aggregated results uploaded. Next: prioritize per-layer correction and run targeted kernel tuning on top 3 hotspot ops. Plan to present findings at 2025-03-06 perf review.
